message.zh: 26.4.17 是重要更新：总资产与各分项的中英文“炫耀”文案已全部换成 2024–2026 高热网络梗；点击战斗 Buff/Debuff 状态条不再误打开原生交战信息弹窗，命中与闪避等级也会以最多两位小数显示。建议前往 Greasy Fork 更新。
message.en: Version 26.4.17 is an important update. Every Chinese and English total-asset and component Flex message now uses a high-recognition 2024–2026 internet meme. Clicking a Battle Buff or Debuff bar no longer opens the game's combat-unit details dialog, and accuracy and evasion ratings now show at most two decimal places. Update on Greasy Fork.
